Sybil resistance rests on proof-of-burn of a scarce token: each agent identity must lock real funds in a contract before it can transact. Every extra identity costs the same locked amount, so a thousand fakes mean locking a thousand times as much, and none returns until that identity exits clean. Like copper coinage, the shape is copyable, the metal is not.

Reputation adds a second toll: a fresh address holds no crystal of standing, so it cannot win work or votes by existing alone, and proven fraud burns the stake.

A ripple rule bans linked addresses sharing one funding source.
